content.title: When do the NHL playoffs start? Dates to know for hockey's postseason
content.text: April 13, 2026, 11:12 a.m. ETThe NHL playoffs are approaching.Teams have just a few remaining games left before the April 16 end of the regular season as the last few contenders try to cement playoff positions.So far, the Carolina Hurricanes, Buffalo Sabres, Montreal Canadiens, Tampa Bay Lightning, Pittsburgh Penguins, Ottawa Senators and Boston Bruins have clinched Eastern Conference playoff spots.Meanwhile, the Colorado Avalanche, Dallas Stars, Minnesota Wild, Utah Mammoth, Edmonton Oilers and Vegas Golden Knights clinched in the West.Three more teams have the potential to clinch berths during Monday's 10-game schedule. Here's what to know about the 2026 NHL playoffs, including when it starts.When do the NHL playoffs start?Saturday, April 18.When does the NHL regular season end?Thursday, April 16, with six games.When is the Stanley Cup?While the exact day for the Stanley Cup has yet to be determined, the last possible day for it is June 21, per the NHL.How many teams compete in the Stanley Cup Playoffs?A total of 16 teams qualify for the Stanley Cup Playoffs.As of 11 a.m. on Monday, April 13, only 13 teams had clinched a playoff spot.Who won the Stanley Cup in 2025?The Florida Panthers won the 2025 Stanley Cup after defeating the Edmonton Oilers in six games. It was the Panthers' second straight Stanley Cup win. Their first came in 2024 when they defeated the Oilers in seven games.Which teams are in the 2026 NHL playoffs so far?Eastern Conference:Buffalo Sabres.Carolina Hurricanes.Tampa Bay Lightning.Montreal Canadiens.Pittsburgh Penguins.Ottawa Senators.Boston Bruins.Western Conference:Colorado Avalanche.Dallas Stars.Minnesota Wild.Utah Mammoth.Edmonton Oilers.Vegas Golden Knights.NHL games today (Monday, April 13)Here is the entire NHL schedule for Monday, April 13.Detroit Red Wings vs. Tampa Bay Lightning – 7:00 p.m. ET (ESPN+).New York Rangers vs. Florida Panthers – 7:00 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Carolina Hurricanes vs. Philadelphia Flyers – 7:00 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Dallas Stars vs. Toronto Maple Leafs – 7:30 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Minnesota Wild vs. St. Louis Blues – 8:00 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Nashville Predators vs. San Jose Sharks – 8:00 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Buffalo Sabres vs. Chicago Blackhawks – 8:30 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Colorado Avalanche vs. Edmonton Oilers – 9:30 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Los Angeles Kings vs. Seattle Kraken – 9:30 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Winnipeg Jets vs. Vegas Golden Knights – 10:00 p.m. ET (ESPN+).Watch NHL games all season long on ESPN+
